🎷 Unit 9: The 1920s & Harlem Renaissance

The Great Migration, the Harlem Renaissance and jazz, Prohibition and gangsters, flappers, the Scopes Trial.
Goes with the class Canvas module: “1920s unit (Dec-Jan): Great Migration & Harlem Renaissance notes, Jacob Lawrence, Red Summer & Tulsa, Minstrel, Jazz, gangsters, Prohibition, The Century: Boom to Bust, slang, Jeopardy”.

👩‍🏫 Staff note: Sensitive topic: the “Minstrel Shows & Blackface” lesson notes cover the history of racism in entertainment. They frame minstrelsy and blackface as racist and harmful and leave out slurs and caricature images. Please preview the class slides before teaching; Level 1 Basic notes focus on: it was unfair and hurtful, and people fought to end it.

Level 1 Basic 2nd-grade reading: pictures and emoji, one idea at a time
